# Bengaluru Classical — AI Discovery

This site aggregates hardcore Karnatic and Hindustani classical concerts in Bengaluru.

## Read-only MCP server (future)
Endpoint: /mcp (stateless streamable HTTP)
Tools: search_events, get_event, list_venues, list_artists

## Key URLs
- Upcoming events: /
- Event detail: /events/<slug>/
- Calendar ICS feed: /calendar.ics
- Archive: /archive/
- Series: /festivals/<slug>/

## Coverage
Genre: Karnatic (Carnatic) and Hindustani classical only (no film/fusion/pop)
City: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

## Contact
Takedown/corrections: contact@example.com
